_note: Krino Tree 节点的实际进度。和节点性质（产品/研究/外部突破/阶段终点）是两回事：性质来自 V3，进度只来自这里。只写核实过的；没写的节点按 defaults 取（按阶段：前两阶段 planned，后两阶段 vision）。阶段终点和汇合门（structure.json 的 milestones）不在这里写，由前置自动算：前置全部 completed 才算 completed（ASCENSION 是四道门任一）。改进度只改这个文件再重跑 build.py；写 completed 必须给出 evidence，build 会检查。

zh: KRINO WORLD 已上线：国内版、海外版（目前内测，未开放公开注册）
长期记忆：按重要程度与时间衰减（遗忘曲线），用户能查看、修改、让它忘记、再恢复
关系状态（羁绊）与会话摘要，换话题后仍记得共同经历
关系导出与导入（格式 krino-relation/1）；人设版本、导出可把灵魂与形象带到另一个账号
注销账号即删除角色、记忆与聊天
en: KRINO WORLD is live in a China edition and a global edition (closed beta, public sign-up not open yet)
Long-term memory that decays by importance and time (a forgetting curve); users can view, edit, make it forget and restore
Relationship state (bond) and session summaries, so shared history survives a change of topic
Relationship export and import (format krino-relation/1); persona versions, and exports that carry a character's soul and look to another account
Deleting an account deletes its characters, memories and chats

zh: 验收标准里的“换底层模型、换设备后仍正确记得共同经历，分清发生过与只是讨论过”还没有自动化的连续性测试
“迁移后记忆完整性可自动验证”：目前有导出导入的往返测试，没有完整性审计
en: The pass criterion "still remembers shared history correctly after switching the underlying model or device, and tells what happened from what was only discussed" has no automated continuity test yet
"Memory integrity can be verified automatically after migration": export/import round-trips are tested, but there is no integrity audit yet

seed.decision: 2026-11-10 由公司确认：软件 MVP（KRINO WORLD）视为本节点完成；V3 验收标准中尚未自动化的两项列为后续加强，公开展示。

zh: 统一的设备适配层（Device Adapter）：设备的摄像头、麦克风、头部姿态接入同一套互动流程，输出经过校验的 AR 显示事件
浏览器里的 KRINO GLASSES 模拟器（应用内“设置 → 高级”），用来开发和测试眼镜上的交互
en: A unified Device Adapter: a device's camera, microphone and head pose feed the same interaction pipeline, which emits validated AR display events
A KRINO GLASSES simulator in the browser (in the app under Settings → Advanced) for building and testing the in-glasses experience

zh: 还没有接入任何真实眼镜硬件，也没有硬件合作或出货
验收标准（全天佩戴留存、<70 g 全天续航、走动与打断后能正确继续）均未开始验证
en: No real glasses hardware is connected yet, and there is no hardware partnership or shipment
None of the pass criteria (all-day wear retention, all-day battery under 70 g, correct continuation after walking around and interruptions) have been tested

zh: 相关的现有能力：KRINO WORLD 已能导出你和一个角色之间的记忆与关系（JSON），这是本节点的起点，不是本节点本身
en: Related existing capability: KRINO WORLD can already export the memories and relationship between you and a character (JSON). That is a starting point for this node, not the node itself

zh: 相关的现有能力：应用里的统一设备适配层（Device Adapter）已把设备的摄像头、麦克风、头部姿态接入同一套互动流程，这是本节点的起点，不是本节点本身
en: Related existing capability: the app's unified Device Adapter already feeds a device's camera, microphone and head pose into one interaction pipeline. That is a starting point for this node, not the node itself

zh: 公开的 API 文档与 SDK 文档、SDK 本身、接入示例都还没有开始写
en: The public API docs, SDK docs, the SDKs themselves and integration examples haven't been started
